name: Almawarid Manpower Company
summary: Almawarid Manpower Company provides recruitment services for domestic workers, expatriate labor services, and operates temporary employment agency for domestic services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company engages in the recruitment of workforce at the various occupational levels for individuals, firms and companies of the private sector, the governments, and mixed institutions. It also offers workforce services for home, such as private driver, female domestic worker, house cook, home farmer, nanny, home expeditor, house tea boy, physical therapist, home nurse, home manager, and home tailor; and building renovation, maintenance, general building cleaning, administrative and support, construction, and catering services. In addition, the company is involved in the searching of employees for positions, including induction or testing and online recruitment agencies, as well as provision of other human resources comprising Saudi human resources on a long-term or permanent basis. Almawarid Manpower Company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
